hub.title: Account
hub.subtitle: Everything about your own account in one place: who you are, your notifications, connected AI apps, password and sessions, and your preferences.

identity.title: You
identity.name: Name
identity.errorDescription: Your account details failed to load.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: The assets assigned to you, the applications you can access and your access requests.

notifications.title: Notification emails
notifications.description: Choose which notifications lazyit emails you. The in-app bell is unaffected.

ai.title: AI & connected apps
ai.description: Connect Claude Code and other AI apps, and review or revoke the ones you connected.

secrets.title: Secret Manager
secrets.description: Your personal vault password and recovery key live with your vaults.

password.title: Password
password.local: Your password is a lazyit password. Changing it keeps you signed in here and signs you out everywhere else.
password.identityProvider: Your password is managed by your organization's sign-in provider. Change it there.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.local: Signing out ends every session you have — this browser, your other computers and your phone, including sessions kept with "Keep me signed in".
sessions.identityProvider: Signing out ends your session in this browser. Your sign-in provider manages your sessions elsewhere.
sessions.unknown: Signing out ends your session in this browser.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Saved in this browser. System follows your device's setting.

notifications.title: Notification emails
notifications.subtitle: Choose which notifications lazyit emails you. Your in-app bell is unaffected.

card.title: Email me about
card.description: Turn a notification off to stop receiving it by email. You still see every notification in your in-app bell. Only notifications your instance can email are shown.

notifications.empty: There are no notification emails to configure. Your instance may not have email configured yet, or none of your notifications can be emailed.

error.title: Couldn't load your preferences
error.description: Your notification email preferences failed to load.

critical_app_access.label: Critical-app access
critical_app_access.description: A grant opened access to an application flagged as critical.

admin_granted.label: Admin granted
admin_granted.description: A grant or role change raised someone to the Administrator role.

low_stock.label: Low stock
low_stock.description: A consumable dropped to or below its minimum stock level.

workflow_manual_task.label: Manual task waiting
workflow_manual_task.description: A workflow run paused and is waiting for a person to act.

workflow_run_failed.label: Workflow run failed
workflow_run_failed.description: A workflow run failed or escalated and stopped.

permission_widened.label: Sensitive permission granted
permission_widened.description: A role-permission edit gave the Member or Viewer role a high-risk capability.

infra_agent_offline.label: Agent offline
infra_agent_offline.description: A reporting agent stopped sending reports and its node was flipped offline.

update_available.label: Update available
update_available.description: A newer lazyit release than the one you're running is available.

access_request_decided.label: Access request decided
access_request_decided.description: One of your access requests was approved or denied.

warranty_expiring.label: Warranty expiring
warranty_expiring.description: An asset's warranty is approaching its end date.

access_grant_expiring.label: Access expiring
access_grant_expiring.description: An access grant is about to expire and be auto-revoked.

asset_assignment_acknowledged.label: Receipt acknowledged
asset_assignment_acknowledged.description: Someone confirmed receipt of an asset you assigned to them.

mcp_client_connected.label: New AI agent connected
mcp_client_connected.description: An external AI agent (MCP) was connected to your account for the first time.
